parameters.name: viscous_sublayer_thickness
parameters.justification: 5 nu/u_tau with u_tau = sqrt(tau/rho) = sqrt(18/1025) = 0.13 m/s, consistent with wall_shear_stress = 18 Pa.

parameters.name: sublayer_edge_velocity
parameters.justification: Mean velocity at y+ = 5, i.e. 5 u_tau = 5*0.13 m/s, held fixed so that only the wall condition changes.
